prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1378; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. Should you receive any statement, request, or inquiry from our client, please refer it to us promptly.

We ask that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page and disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, together with any other coverage that may apply.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any physical components of the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm in writing that the requested preservation steps have been taken. We look forward to your prompt response.
